student.title: Tababarkayga
student.empty: Weli ma haysatid meelayn tababar. Marka aad aqbasho dalab, halkan ayuu ka soo muuqan doonaa.
student.subtitle: Tababarradaada hadda iyo kuwii hore.
student.emptyHint: Marka aad aqbasho dalab tababar, tababarkaagu halkan ayuu ka muuqan doonaa oo ay la socdaan wax kasta oo aad u baahan tahay si aad u dhammaystirto.

university.title: Meelaynta ardayda
university.description: Tababarada ay ardaydaadu hadda qaadanayaan, gudaha xuduudkaaga.
university.noMatches: Tababar ku habboon shaandhooyinkan ma jiro
university.emptyHint: Tababarradu halkan ayay ka muuqan doonaan marka mid ka mid ah ardaydaadu aqbalo dalab.
university.emptySupervisorHint: Tababarradu halkan ayay ka muuqan doonaan marka laguu xilsaaro kormeeraha tacliinta ee arday.

organization.title: Tababarayaasha
organization.empty: Weli tababarayaal ma jiraan. Tababarayaasha halkan ayaa lagu daraa marka musharraxu aqbalo dalab tababar.
organization.searchPlaceholder: Ku raadi magac, jaamacad ama tababar
organization.emptyHint: Tababartayaashu halkan ayay ka muuqdaan marka musharrax uu aqbalo dalab tababar.

detail.evaluationHint: Qiimaynta ururka martida loo yahay halkan ayay ka muuqan doontaa marka ay dhammaystirto.
detail.evaluationUnavailable: Qiimeyntaada lama soo bandhigi karin. Taasi macnaheedu maaha inay maqan tahay.

noneEligible.UNIVERSITY: Kormeerayaal jaamacadeed lama helin. Maamulaha jaamacaddu waa inuu marka hore ku daraa shaqaale leh doorka kormeeraha.
noneEligible.ORGANIZATION: Kormeerayaal hay'adeed lama helin. Maamulaha hay'addu waa inuu marka hore ku daraa shaqaale leh doorka kormeeraha.

errors.SUPERVISOR_WRONG_UNIVERSITY: Kormeerahaasi wuxuu ka tirsan yahay jaamacad kale.
errors.SUPERVISOR_WRONG_ORGANIZATION: Kormeerahaasi wuxuu ka tirsan yahay hay'ad kale.
errors.ACCESS_DENIED: Ma haysatid oggolaansho aad ku magacaabto kormeerahan.
errors.generic: Kormeeraha lama magacaabi karin. Fadlan mar kale isku day.

history.title: Taariikhda kormeerka
history.description: Mudo kasta oo kormeer ah waa la hayaa, oo ay ku jiraan kormeerayaashii hore.

actions.title: Maaree meelaynta
actions.reasonPlaceholder: Si kooban u sharax waxa dhacay.

confirm.cancel: Meelayntan ma bilaaban, sidaas darteed waa la joojin doonaa. Tan lama celin karo.
confirm.terminate: Tababarkani horeba wuu u bilaabmay, sidaas darteed waxaa loo diiwaan gelin doonaa mid goor hore la joojiyay. Tan lama celin karo.

terminalNote.CANCELLED: Meelayntan waa la joojiyay ka hor inta uusan bilaaban.

errors.PLACEMENT_INVALID_TRANSITION: Meelayntani mar dambe uma guuri karto xaaladdaas.
errors.ACCESS_DENIED: Ma haysatid oggolaansho aad ku maamusho meelayntan.
errors.generic: Meelaynta lama cusboonaysiin karin. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
